name: Video
summary: Play local videos with keypad controls
description: Find indexed videos on the phone and SD card. Use the directional keys to seek and the center key to pause and resume.
author: thooton

changes.text: Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
The list refreshes when you come back, long names keep their ending, and an unplayable video's message names it and stays longer.
Coming back to a paused video keeps its place, the focused row is easy to see, and the player is full screen with a progress bar.
